程序包 org.bukkit.event.player

类 PlayerInteractEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerInteractEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
public class PlayerInteractEvent extends PlayerEvent implements Cancellable
Called when a player interacts with an object or air. 当玩家与物体或空气交互时调用。

This event will fire as cancelled if the vanilla behavior is to do nothing (e.g interacting with air) 如果原版行为是什么都不做（例如与空气交互），此事件将以已取消的状态触发

    • isCancelled

      public boolean isCancelled()
      Gets the cancellation state of this event. Set to true if you want to prevent buckets from placing water and so forth 获取该事件的取消状态。如果你想阻止桶放置水等行为，则设为 true
      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      boolean cancellation state 取消状态

    • setCancelled

      public void setCancelled(boolean cancel)
      Sets the cancellation state of this event. A canceled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins 设置该事件的取消状态。已取消的事件不会在服务器中执行，但仍会传递给其他插件

      Canceling this event will prevent use of food (player won't lose the food item), prevent bows/snowballs/eggs from firing, etc. (player won't lose the ammo) 取消此事件将阻止食物的使用（玩家不会失去食物物品）、阻止弓/雪球/鸡蛋等的发射（玩家不会失去弹药）

      指定者:
      setCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      参数:
      cancel - true if you wish to cancel this event 若希望取消该事件则为 true

    • useInteractedBlock

      public Event.Result useInteractedBlock()
      This controls the action to take with the block (if any) that was clicked on. This event gets processed for all blocks, but most don't have a default action 这控制对被点击方块（若有）要采取的动作。此事件会针对所有方块处理，但大多数方块没有默认动作
      返回:
      the action to take with the interacted block 对被交互方块采取的动作

    • useItemInHand

      public Event.Result useItemInHand()
      This controls the action to take with the item the player is holding. This includes both blocks and items (such as flint and steel or records). When this is set to default, it will be allowed if no action is taken on the interacted block. 这控制对玩家手持物品要采取的动作。这包括方块和物品（如打火石或唱片）。当此值设为 default 时，若对被交互方块未采取任何动作，则该物品的使用将被允许。
      返回:
      the action to take with the item in hand 对手持物品采取的动作
